ayahs.textArabic: الٓمٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alif-Laam-Meeem
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Alif, Lam, Meem.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Alif-Lãm-Mĩm.

ayahs.textArabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلۡحَيُّ ٱلۡقَيُّومُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allaahu laaa ilaaha illaa Huwal Haiyul Qaiyoom
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Allah! There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him—the Ever-Living, All-Sustaining.

ayahs.textArabic: نَزَّلَ عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ مُصَدِّقٗا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِ وَأَنزَلَ ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةَ وَٱلۡإِنجِيلَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Nazzala 'alaikal Kitaaba bilhaqqi musaddiqal limaa baina yadaihi wa-anzalat Tawraata wal-Injeel
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He has sent down upon you, [O Muhammad], the Book in truth, confirming what was before it. And He revealed the Torah and the Gospel.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He has revealed to you ˹O Prophet˺ the Book in truth, confirming what came before it, as He revealed the Torah and the Gospel

ayahs.textArabic: مِن قَبۡلُ هُدٗى لِّلنَّاسِ وَأَنزَلَ ٱلۡفُرۡقَانَۗ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ شَدِيدٞۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٞ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Min qablu hudal linnaasi wa-anzalal Furqaan:(a) innal lazeena kafaroo bi-Aayaatil laahi lahum 'azaabun shadeed:(unw) wallaahu 'azeezun zun tiqaam
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Before, as guidance for the people. And He revealed the Qur'an. Indeed, those who disbelieve in the verses of Allah will have a severe punishment, and Allah is exalted in Might, the Owner of Retribution.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: previously, as a guide for people, and ˹also˺ revealed the Standard ˹to distinguish between right and wrong˺. Surely those who reject Allah’s revelations will suffer a severe torment. For Allah is Almighty, capable of punishment.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَخۡفَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ شَيۡءٞ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innal laaha laa yakhfaa 'alaihi shai'un fil ardi wa-laa fis samaaa'
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, from Allah nothing is hidden in the earth nor in the heaven.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely nothing on earth or in the heavens is hidden from Allah.

ayahs.textArabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُصَوِّرُكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡحَامِ كَيۡفَ يَشَآءُۚ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Huwal lazee yusawwi-rukum fil arhaami kaifa yashaaa,('oo) laa ilaaha illaa Huwal 'Azeezul Hakeem
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It is He who forms you in the wombs however He wills. There is no deity except Him, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He is the One Who shapes you in the wombs of your mothers as He wills. There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him—the Almighty, All-Wise.

ayahs.textArabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ مِنۡهُ ءَايَٰتٞ مُّحۡكَمَٰتٌ هُنَّ أُمُّ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَأُخَرُ مُتَشَٰبِهَٰتٞۖ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمۡ زَيۡغٞ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ مَا تَشَٰبَهَ مِنۡهُ ٱبۡتِغَآءَ ٱلۡفِتۡنَةِ وَٱبۡتِغَآءَ تَأۡوِيلِهِۦۖ وَمَا يَعۡلَمُ تَأۡوِيلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُۗ وَٱلرَّٰسِخُونَ فِي ٱلۡعِلۡمِ يَقُولُونَ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ كُلّٞ مِّنۡ عِندِ رَبِّنَاۗ وَمَا يَذَّكَّرُ إِلَّآ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Huwal lazeee anzala 'alaikal Kitaaba minhu Aayaatum Muh-kamaatun hunna Ummul Kitaabi wa-ukharu Muta-shaabihaat(un); fa-ammal lazeena fee quloobihim zaiyghun fa-yattabi'oona ma tashaa-baha minhub tighaaa 'alfitnati wabtighaaa'a ta`weelih:(i) wa-maa ya'lamu ta`wee-lahooo illal laah:(u) war-raasi-khoona fil 'ilmi yaqooloona aamannaa bihee kullum min 'indi Rabbinaa: wa-maa yazzakkaru illaaa ulul albaab
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It is He who has sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Book; in it are verses [that are] precise - they are the foundation of the Book - and others unspecific. As for those in whose hearts is deviation [from truth], they will follow that of it which is unspecific, seeking discord and seeking an interpretation [suitable to them]. And no one knows its [true] interpretation except Allah. But those firm in knowledge say, "We believe in it. All [of it] is from our Lord." And no one will be reminded except those of understanding.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He is the One Who has revealed to you ˹O Prophet˺ the Book, of which some verses are precise—they are the foundation of the Book—while others are elusive. Those with deviant hearts follow the elusive verses seeking ˹to spread˺ doubt through their ˹false˺ interpretations—but none grasps their ˹full˺ meaning except Allah. As for those well-grounded in knowledge, they say, “We believe in this ˹Quran˺—it is all from our Lord.” But none will be mindful ˹of this˺ except people of reason.

ayahs.textArabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغۡ قُلُوبَنَا بَعۡدَ إِذۡ هَدَيۡتَنَا وَهَبۡ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحۡمَةًۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡوَهَّابُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Rabbanaa laa tuzigh quloobanaa ba'da iz hadaitanaa wa-hab lanaa mil ladunka rahmah,(tan) innaka antal Wahhaab
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Who say], "Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They say,˺ “Our Lord! Do not let our hearts deviate after you have guided us. Grant us Your mercy. You are indeed the Giver ˹of all bounties˺.

ayahs.textArabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ ٱلنَّاسِ لِيَوۡمٖ لَّا رَيۡبَ فِيهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخۡلِفُ ٱلۡمِيعَادَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Rabbanaaa innaka jaami 'un-naasi li-Yawmil laa raiba feeh,(i) innal laaha laa yukhliful mee'aad
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allah does not fail in His promise."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Our Lord! You will certainly gather all humanity for the ˹promised˺ Day—about which there is no doubt. Surely Allah does not break His promise.”

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَن تُغۡنِيَ عَنۡهُمۡ أَمۡوَٰلُهُمۡ وَلَآ أَوۡلَٰدُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـٔٗاۖ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ وَقُودُ ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innal lazeena kafaroo lan tughniya 'anhum am-waaluhum wa-laaa aw-laaduhum minal laahi shai'a(nw); wa-ulaaa'ika hum waqoodun Naar
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, those who disbelieve - never will their wealth or their children avail them against Allah at all. And it is they who are fuel for the Fire.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, neither the wealth nor children of the disbelievers will be of any benefit to them against Allah—and they will be the fuel for the Fire.

ayahs.textArabic: كَدَأۡبِ ءَالِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمۡۗ وَٱللَّهُ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kada`abi Aali Fir'awna wallazeena min qablihim, kazzaboo bi-Aayaatinaa fa-akhaza-humul laahu bi-zunoo-bihim: wallaahu shadeedul 'iqaab
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Theirs is] like the custom of the people of Pharaoh and those before them. They denied Our signs, so Allah seized them for their sins. And Allah is severe in penalty.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Their fate will be like that of the people of Pharaoh and those before them—they all rejected Our signs, so Allah seized them for their sins. And Allah is severe in punishment.

ayahs.textArabic: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ سَتُغۡلَبُونَ وَتُحۡشَرُونَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمِهَادُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul lillazeena kafaroo satugh-laboona wa-tuh`sharoona ilaa jahannam,(a) wa-bi'sal mihaad
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say to those who disbelieve, "You will be overcome and gathered together to Hell, and wretched is the resting place."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹O Prophet!˺ Tell the disbelievers, “Soon you will be overpowered and driven to Hell—what an evil place to rest!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَدۡ كَانَ لَكُمۡ ءَايَةٞ فِي فِئَتَيۡنِ ٱلۡتَقَتَاۖ فِئَةٞ تُقَٰتِلُ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَأُخۡرَىٰ كَافِرَةٞ يَرَوۡنَهُم مِّثۡلَيۡهِمۡ رَأۡيَ ٱلۡعَيۡنِۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُؤَيِّدُ بِنَصۡرِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبۡرَةٗ لِّأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qad kaana lakum Aayatun fee fi'atainil taqat(aa); fi'atun tuqaatilu fee sabeelil laahi wa-ukhraa kaafiratuien yaraw`nahum mis`laihim ra`ayal 'ayn,(i) wallaahu yu'ayyidu bi-nasrihee maien yashaaa':(u) innaa fee zaalika la-'ibratal li-ulil absaar
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Already there has been for you a sign in the two armies which met - one fighting in the cause of Allah and another of disbelievers. They saw them [to be] twice their [own] number by [their] eyesight. But Allah supports with His victory whom He wills. Indeed in that is a lesson for those of vision.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, there was a sign for you in the two armies that met in battle—one fighting for the cause of Allah and the other in denial. The believers saw their enemy twice their number. But Allah supports with His victory whoever He wills. Surely in this is a lesson for people of insight.

ayahs.textArabic: زُيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ حُبُّ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ مِنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ وَٱلۡبَنِينَ وَٱلۡقَنَٰطِيرِ ٱلۡمُقَنطَرَةِ مِنَ ٱلذَّهَبِ وَٱلۡفِضَّةِ وَٱلۡخَيۡلِ ٱلۡمُسَوَّمَةِ وَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ وَٱلۡحَرۡثِۗ ذَٰلِكَ مَتَٰعُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥ حُسۡنُ ٱلۡمَـَٔابِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Zuyyina linnaasi hubbush shahawaati minan nisaaa'i wal-baneena wal-qanaa-teeril muqan-tarati minaz zahabi wal-fiddati wal-khailil musaw-wamati wal-an'aami walhars:(i) zaalika mataa'ul hayaatid dunyaa; wallaahu 'indahoo husnul ma-aab
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Beautified for people is the love of that which they desire - of women and sons, heaped-up sums of gold and silver, fine branded horses, and cattle and tilled land. That is the enjoyment of worldly life, but Allah has with Him the best return.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The enjoyment of ˹worldly˺ desires—women, children, treasures of gold and silver, fine horses, cattle, and fertile land—has been made appealing to people. These are the pleasures of this worldly life, but with Allah is the finest destination.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ قُلۡ أَؤُنَبِّئُكُم بِخَيۡرٖ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمۡۖ لِلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّٰتٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَأَزۡوَٰجٞ مُّطَهَّرَةٞ وَرِضۡوَٰنٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِۗ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرُۢ بِٱلۡعِبَادِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: ^Qul a'unabbi-'ukum bikhairim min zaalikum, lil-lazeenat taqaw 'inda Rabbihim jannaatun tajree min tah-tihal anhaaru khaalideena feehaa wa-azwaajum mutah-haratunw wa-ridwaanum minal laah:(i) wallaahu baseerum bil'ibaad
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "Shall I inform you of [something] better than that? For those who fear Allah will be gardens in the presence of their Lord beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally, and purified spouses and approval from Allah. And Allah is Seeing of [His] servants -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Shall I inform you of what is better than ˹all of˺ this? Those mindful ˹of Allah˺ will have Gardens with their Lord under which rivers flow, to stay there forever, and pure spouses, along with Allah’s pleasure.” And Allah is All-Seeing of ˹His˺ servants,

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allazeena yaqooloona Rabbanaaa innanaaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa zunoobanaa wa-qinaa 'azaaban Naar
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Those who say, "Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire,"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: who pray, “Our Lord! We have believed, so forgive our sins and protect us from the torment of the Fire.”

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ وَٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ وَٱلۡقَٰنِتِينَ وَٱلۡمُنفِقِينَ وَٱلۡمُسۡتَغۡفِرِينَ بِٱلۡأَسۡحَارِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Assaabireena wassaa-diqeena walqaaniteena walmunfiqeena walmus-taghfireena bil-as-haar
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The patient, the true, the obedient, those who spend [in the way of Allah], and those who seek forgiveness before dawn.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹It is they˺ who are patient, sincere, obedient, and charitable, and who pray for forgiveness before dawn.

ayahs.textArabic: شَهِدَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَأُوْلُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمِ قَآئِمَۢا بِٱلۡقِسۡطِۚ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Shahidal laahu annahoo laa ilaaha illaa Huwa wal-malaaa'ikatu wa-ulul 'ilmi qaaa'imam bilqist; laaa ilaaha illaa Huwal 'Azeezul Hakeem
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Allah witnesses that there is no deity except Him, and [so do] the angels and those of knowledge - [that He is] maintaining [creation] in justice. There is no deity except Him, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Allah ˹Himself˺ is a Witness that there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him—and so are the angels and people of knowledge. He is the Maintainer of justice. There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him—the Almighty, All-Wise.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡإِسۡلَٰمُۗ وَمَا ٱخۡتَلَفَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡعِلۡمُ بَغۡيَۢا بَيۡنَهُمۡۗ وَمَن يَكۡفُرۡ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innad deena 'indal laahil Islaam;(u) wamakh talafal lazeena ootul Kitaaba illaa mim ba'di maa jaaa'ahumul 'ilmu baghyam bainahum: wa-mai yakfur bi-Aayaatil laahi fa-innal laaha saree'ul hisaab
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, the religion in the sight of Allah is Islam. And those who were given the Scripture did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And whoever disbelieves in the verses of Allah, then indeed, Allah is swift in [taking] account.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Certainly, Allah’s only Way is Islam. Those who were given the Scripture did not dispute ˹among themselves˺ out of mutual envy until knowledge came to them. Whoever denies Allah’s signs, then surely Allah is swift in reckoning.

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِنۡ حَآجُّوكَ فَقُلۡ أَسۡلَمۡتُ وَجۡهِيَ لِلَّهِ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَنِۗ وَقُل لِّلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡأُمِّيِّـۧنَ ءَأَسۡلَمۡتُمۡۚ فَإِنۡ أَسۡلَمُواْ فَقَدِ ٱهۡتَدَواْۖ وَّإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡبَلَٰغُۗ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرُۢ بِٱلۡعِبَادِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fa-in haaaj-jooka faqul aslamtu wajhiya lillaahi wa-manit taba'an:(i) wa-qul lillazeena ootul Kitaaba wal-ummiyyeena 'a-aslamtum, fa-in aslamoo faqadih tadaw; wa-in tawallaw fa-innamaa 'alaikal balaagh:(u) wallaahu baseerum bil-'ibaad
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So if they argue with you, say, "I have submitted myself to Allah [in Islam], and [so have] those who follow me." And say to those who were given the Scripture and [to] the unlearned, "Have you submitted yourselves?" And if they submit [in Islam], they are rightly guided; but if they turn away - then upon you is only the [duty of] notification. And Allah is Seeing of [His] servants.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So if they argue with you ˹O Prophet˺, say, “I have submitted myself to Allah, and so have my followers.” And ask those who were given the Scripture and the illiterate ˹people˺, “Have you submitted yourselves ˹to Allah˺?” If they submit, they will be ˹rightly˺ guided. But if they turn away, then your duty is only to deliver ˹the message˺. And Allah is All-Seeing of ˹His˺ servants.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكۡفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقۡتُلُونَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ بِغَيۡرِ حَقّٖ وَيَقۡتُلُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَأۡمُرُونَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ فَبَشِّرۡهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innal lazeena yakfuroona bi-Aayaatil laahi wa-yaqtuloonan Nabiyyeena bighairi haqqinw wa-yaqtuloonal lazeena yaa`muroona bilqisti minan naasi fabash-shirhum bi'azaabin aleem
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Those who disbelieve in the signs of Allah and kill the prophets without right and kill those who order justice from among the people - give them tidings of a painful punishment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, those who deny Allah’s signs, kill the prophets unjustly, and kill people who stand up for justice—give them good news of a painful punishment.

ayahs.textArabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَبِطَتۡ أَعۡمَٰلُهُمۡ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ulaaa'ikal lazeena habitat a'maaluhum fid dunyaa wal-Aaakhirah(ti) wa-maa lahum min naasireen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They are the ones whose deeds have become worthless in this world and the Hereafter, and for them there will be no helpers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They are the ones whose deeds are wasted in this world and the Hereafter. And they will have no helpers.

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ نَصِيبٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ يُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَىٰ كِتَٰبِ ٱللَّهِ لِيَحۡكُمَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّىٰ فَرِيقٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ وَهُم مُّعۡرِضُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alam tara ilal lazeena ootoo naseebam minal Kitaabi yud'awna ilaa Kitaabil laahi liyah-kuma bai-nahum summa yata-wallaa fareequm minhum wa-hum mu'ridoon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Do you not consider, [O Muhammad], those who were given a portion of the Scripture? They are invited to the Scripture of Allah that it should arbitrate between them; then a party of them turns away, and they are refusing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Have you not seen those who were given a portion of the Scriptures? Yet when they are invited to the Book of Allah to settle their disputes, some of them turn away heedlessly.

ayahs.textArabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ قَالُواْ لَن تَمَسَّنَا ٱلنَّارُ إِلَّآ أَيَّامٗا مَّعۡدُودَٰتٖۖ وَغَرَّهُمۡ فِي دِينِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ يَفۡتَرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Zaalika bi-annahum qaaloo lan tamassanan naaru illaaa ayyaamam ma'doodaat(inw); wa-gharrahum fee deenihim maa kaanoo yaftaroon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That is because they say, "Never will the Fire touch us except for [a few] numbered days," and [because] they were deluded in their religion by what they were inventing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This is because they say, “The Fire will not touch us except for a few days.” They have been deceived in their faith by their wishful lying.

ayahs.textArabic: فَكَيۡفَ إِذَا جَمَعۡنَٰهُمۡ لِيَوۡمٖ لَّا رَيۡبَ فِيهِ وَوُفِّيَتۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ مَّا كَسَبَتۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fa-kaifa izaa jama'naahum li-Yawmil laa raiba fee wa-wuffiyat kullu nafsim maa kasabat wa-hum laa yuzlamoon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So how will it be when We assemble them for a Day about which there is no doubt? And each soul will be compensated [in full for] what it earned, and they will not be wronged.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But how ˹horrible˺ will it be when We gather them together on the Day about which there is no doubt—when every soul will be paid in full for what it has done, and none will be wronged!

ayahs.textArabic: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ مَٰلِكَ ٱلۡمُلۡكِ تُؤۡتِي ٱلۡمُلۡكَ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتَنزِعُ ٱلۡمُلۡكَ مِمَّن تَشَآءُ وَتُعِزُّ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَن تَشَآءُۖ بِيَدِكَ ٱلۡخَيۡرُۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qulil laahumma Maalikal Mulki tu'til mulka man tashaaa'u wa-tanzi'ul mulka mimman tashhaaa'u wa-tu'izzu man tashaaa'u wa-tuzillu man tashaaa'(u); biyadikal khair(u); innaka 'alaa kulli shai'in Qadeer
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "O Allah, Owner of Sovereignty, You give sovereignty to whom You will and You take sovereignty away from whom You will. You honor whom You will and You humble whom You will. In Your hand is [all] good. Indeed, You are over all things competent.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “O Allah! Lord over all authorities! You give authority to whoever You please and remove it from who You please; You honour whoever You please and disgrace who You please—all good is in Your Hands. Surely You ˹alone˺ are Most Capable of everything.

ayahs.textArabic: تُولِجُ ٱلَّيۡلَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ وَتُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِي ٱلَّيۡلِۖ وَتُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡحَيَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمَيِّتِ وَتُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلۡحَيِّۖ وَتَرۡزُقُ مَن تَشَآءُ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Toolijul laila fin nahaari wa-toolijun nahaara fil lail(i); wa-tukhrijul haiya minal maiy-yiti wa-tukhrijul maiy-yita minal haiy(yi); wa-tarzuqu man tashaaa'u bighari hisaab
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: You cause the night to enter the day, and You cause the day to enter the night; and You bring the living out of the dead, and You bring the dead out of the living. And You give provision to whom You will without account."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: You cause the night to pass into the day and the day into the night. You bring forth the living from the dead and the dead from the living. And You provide for whoever You will without limit.”

ayahs.textArabic: لَّا يَتَّخِذِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ أَوۡلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَۖ وَمَن يَفۡعَلۡ ذَٰلِكَ فَلَيۡسَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ فِي شَيۡءٍ إِلَّآ أَن تَتَّقُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ تُقَىٰةٗۗ وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسَهُۥۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Laa yatta-khizil mu'minoonal kaafireena awliyaaa'a min doonil mu'mineen(a); wa-maien yaf'al zaalika falaisa minal laahi fee shai'in illaaa an tat-taqoo minhum tuqaah:(tan) wa-yuhazzi-rukumul laahu nafsah:(u) wa-ilal laahil maseer
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Let not believers take disbelievers as allies rather than believers. And whoever [of you] does that has nothing with Allah, except when taking precaution against them in prudence. And Allah warns you of Himself, and to Allah is the [final] destination.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Believers should not take disbelievers as guardians instead of the believers—and whoever does so will have nothing to hope for from Allah—unless it is a precaution against their tyranny. And Allah warns you about Himself. And to Allah is the final return.

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ إِن تُخۡفُواْ مَا فِي صُدُورِكُمۡ أَوۡ تُبۡدُوهُ يَعۡلَمۡهُ ٱللَّهُۗ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul in tukhfoo maa fee sudoorikum aw tubdoohu ya'lamhul laah:(u) wa-ya'lamu maa fis samaawaati wa-maa fil ard:(i) wallaahu 'alaa kulli shai'in Qadeer
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "Whether you conceal what is in your breasts or reveal it, Allah knows it. And He knows that which is in the heavens and that which is on the earth. And Allah is over all things competent.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Whether you conceal what is in your hearts or reveal it, it is known to Allah. For He knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And Allah is Most Capable of everything.”

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ تَجِدُ كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ مَّا عَمِلَتۡ مِنۡ خَيۡرٖ مُّحۡضَرٗا وَمَا عَمِلَتۡ مِن سُوٓءٖ تَوَدُّ لَوۡ أَنَّ بَيۡنَهَا وَبَيۡنَهُۥٓ أَمَدَۢا بَعِيدٗاۗ وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسَهُۥۗ وَٱللَّهُ رَءُوفُۢ بِٱلۡعِبَادِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma tajidu kullu nafsim maa 'amilat min khairim muh-dara(nw) wa-maa 'amilat min sooo'in tawaddu law anna baina-haa wa-baina-hooo amadam ba'eedaa:(an) wa-yuhazzi-rukumul laahu nafsah:(u) wallaahu ra'oofum bil'ibaad
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Day every soul will find what it has done of good present [before it] and what it has done of evil, it will wish that between itself and that [evil] was a great distance. And Allah warns you of Himself, and Allah is Kind to [His] servants."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Watch for˺ the Day when every soul will be presented with whatever good it has done. And it will wish that its misdeeds were far off. And Allah warns you about Himself. And Allah is Ever Gracious to ˹His˺ servants.

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ تُحِبُّونَ ٱللَّهَ فَٱتَّبِعُونِي يُحۡبِبۡكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَيَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡ ذُنُوبَكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul in kuntum tuhib-boonal laaha fattabi'-oonee yuh`bib-kumul laahu wa-yaghfir lakum zunoobakum: wallaahu Ghafoorur Raheem
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "If you should love Allah, then follow me, [so] Allah will love you and forgive you your sins. And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “If you ˹sincerely˺ love Allah, then follow me; Allah will love you and forgive your sins. For Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ أَطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلرَّسُولَۖ فَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul atee'ul laaha war-Rasool(a); fa-in tawallaw fa-innal laaha laa yuhibbul kaafireen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "Obey Allah and the Messenger." But if they turn away - then indeed, Allah does not like the disbelievers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Obey Allah and His Messenger.” If they still turn away, then truly Allah does not like the disbelievers.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصۡطَفَىٰٓ ءَادَمَ وَنُوحٗا وَءَالَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَءَالَ عِمۡرَٰنَ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: ^Innal laahas tafaaa Aadama wa-Noohanw wa-Aala Ibraaheema wa-Aala Imraana 'alal 'aalameen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, Allah chose Adam and Noah and the family of Abraham and the family of 'Imran over the worlds -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, Allah chose Adam, Noah, the family of Abraham, and the family of ’Imrân above all people ˹of their time˺.

ayahs.textArabic: ذُرِّيَّةَۢ بَعۡضُهَا مِنۢ بَعۡضٖۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Zurriyyatam ba'duhaa mim ba'd:(inw) wallaahu Samee'un 'Aleem
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Descendants, some of them from others. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They are descendants of one another. And Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

ayahs.textArabic: إِذۡ قَالَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُ عِمۡرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّي نَذَرۡتُ لَكَ مَا فِي بَطۡنِي مُحَرَّرٗا فَتَقَبَّلۡ مِنِّيٓۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Iz qaalat im'ra-atu 'Imraana Rabbi innee nazartu laka maa fee batnee muhar-ra-ra(n) fataqabbal min(nee); innaka Antas Samee'ul 'Aleem
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Mention, O Muhammad], when the wife of 'Imran said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Remember˺ when the wife of ’Imrân said, “My Lord! I dedicate what is in my womb entirely to Your service, so accept it from me. You ˹alone˺ are truly the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمَّا وَضَعَتۡهَا قَالَتۡ رَبِّ إِنِّي وَضَعۡتُهَآ أُنثَىٰ وَٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا وَضَعَتۡ وَلَيۡسَ ٱلذَّكَرُ كَٱلۡأُنثَىٰۖ وَإِنِّي سَمَّيۡتُهَا مَرۡيَمَ وَإِنِّيٓ أُعِيذُهَا بِكَ وَذُرِّيَّتَهَا مِنَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fa-lammaa wada'at-haa qaalat Rabbi innee wada'tuhaaa unsaa wallaahu a'lamu bimaa wada'at wa-laisaz zakaru kalunsaa; wa-innee sammai-tuhaa Maryama wa-innee u'eezuhaa bika wa-zurriy-yatahaa minash Shaitaanir Rajeem
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But when she delivered her, she said, "My Lord, I have delivered a female." And Allah was most knowing of what she delivered, "And the male is not like the female. And I have named her Mary, and I seek refuge for her in You and [for] her descendants from Satan, the expelled [from the mercy of Allah]."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: When she delivered, she said, “My Lord! I have given birth to a girl,”—and Allah fully knew what she had delivered—“and the male is not like the female. I have named her Mary, and I seek Your protection for her and her offspring from Satan, the accursed.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٖ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنٗا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّاۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيۡهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلۡمِحۡرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزۡقٗاۖ قَالَ يَٰمَرۡيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَٰذَاۖ قَالَتۡ هُوَ مِنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرۡزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fata-qabba-lahaa Rabbuhaa biqaboolin hasaninw wa-ambatahaa nabaatan hasananw wa-kaffalahaa Zakariyyaa; kullamaa dakhala 'alaihaa Zakariyyal Mihraaba wajada 'indahaa rizqa(n); qaala yaa-Maryamu annaa laki haazaa; qaalat huwa min 'indil laah(i); innal laaha yarzuqu maien yashaaa'u bighairi hisaab
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allah. Indeed, Allah provides for whom He wills without account."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So her Lord accepted her graciously and blessed her with a pleasant upbringing—entrusting her to the care of Zachariah. Whenever Zachariah visited her in the sanctuary, he found her supplied with provisions. He exclaimed, “O Mary! Where did this come from?” She replied, “It is from Allah. Surely Allah provides for whoever He wills without limit.”

ayahs.textArabic: هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهُۥۖ قَالَ رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةٗ طَيِّبَةًۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hunaaa-lika da'aa Zakariyyaa Rabbah(oo); qaala Rabbi hab lee mil ladunka zurriyyatan taiyiba(tan); innaka samee'ud du'aaa'
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: At that, Zechariah called upon his Lord, saying, "My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then and there Zachariah prayed to his Lord, saying, “My Lord! Grant me—by your grace—righteous offspring. You are certainly the Hearer of ˹all˺ prayers.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَنَادَتۡهُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُوَ قَآئِمٞ يُصَلِّي فِي ٱلۡمِحۡرَابِ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكَ بِيَحۡيَىٰ مُصَدِّقَۢا بِكَلِمَةٖ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَسَيِّدٗا وَحَصُورٗا وَنَبِيّٗا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fanaadat-hul malaaa'ikatu wa-huwa qaaa'ee-muien yusallee fil Mihraabi annal laaha yubash-shiruka bi-Yahyaa musaddiqam bi-Kalimatim minal laah(i) wa-saiyidanw wa-hasooranw wa-Nabiyyam minas saaliheen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So the angels called him while he was standing in prayer in the chamber, "Indeed, Allah gives you good tidings of John, confirming a word from Allah and [who will be] honorable, abstaining [from women], and a prophet from among the righteous."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So the angels called out to him while he stood praying in the sanctuary, “Allah gives you good news of ˹the birth of˺ John who will confirm the Word of Allah and will be a great leader, chaste, and a prophet among the righteous.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي غُلَٰمٞ وَقَدۡ بَلَغَنِيَ ٱلۡكِبَرُ وَٱمۡرَأَتِي عَاقِرٞۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفۡعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaala Rabbi annaa yakoonu lee ghulaamunw wa-qad bala-gha-niyal kibaru wam-raatee 'aaqir(un); qaala kazaa-likal laahu yaf'alu maa yashaaa'
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" The angel said, "Such is Allah; He does what He wills."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Zachariah exclaimed, “My Lord! How can I have a son when I am very old and my wife is barren?” He replied, “So will it be. Allah does what He wills.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجۡعَل لِّيٓ ءَايَةٗۖ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَٰثَةَ أَيَّامٍ إِلَّا رَمۡزٗاۗ وَٱذۡكُر رَّبَّكَ كَثِيرٗا وَسَبِّحۡ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ وَٱلۡإِبۡكَٰرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaala Rabbij 'al leee Aayah(tan); qaala Aaayatuka allaa tukalliman naasa salaasata ayyaamin illa ramzaa:(an) wazkur Rabbaka kaseeranw wa-sabbih bil'ashiyyi wal-ib-kaar
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He Said, "Your sign is that you will not [be able to] speak to the people for three days except by gesture. And remember your Lord much and exalt [Him with praise] in the evening and the morning."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Zachariah said, “My Lord! Grant me a sign.” He said, “Your sign is that you will not ˹be able to˺ speak to people for three days except through gestures. Remember your Lord often and glorify ˹Him˺ morning and evening.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَتِ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَٰمَرۡيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصۡطَفَىٰكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَٱصۡطَفَىٰكِ عَلَىٰ نِسَآءِ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-iz qaa-latil malaaa'ikatu yaa-Maryamu innal laahas tafaaki wa-tah-haraki wastafaaki 'alaa nisaaa'il 'aalameen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allah has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And ˹remember˺ when the angels said, “O Mary! Surely Allah has selected you, purified you, and chosen you over all women of the world.

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰمَرۡيَمُ ٱقۡنُتِي لِرَبِّكِ وَٱسۡجُدِي وَٱرۡكَعِي مَعَ ٱلرَّٰكِعِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaa-Maryamu uq-nutee li-Rabbiki wasjudee warka'ee ma'ar raaki'een
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O Mary, be devoutly obedient to your Lord and prostrate and bow with those who bow [in prayer]."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O Mary! Be devout to your Lord, prostrate yourself ˹in prayer˺ and bow along with those who bow down.”

ayahs.textArabic: ذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيۡكَۚ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيۡهِمۡ إِذۡ يُلۡقُونَ أَقۡلَٰمَهُمۡ أَيُّهُمۡ يَكۡفُلُ مَرۡيَمَ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيۡهِمۡ إِذۡ يَخۡتَصِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Zaalika min ambaaa'il ghaibi noo-heehi ilaik,(a) wa-maa kunta ladai`him iz yulqoona aq`laamahum ayyuhum yak-fulu Maryama wa-maa kunta ladai-him iz yakh-tasimoon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal to you, [O Muhammad]. And you were not with them when they cast their pens as to which of them should be responsible for Mary. Nor were you with them when they disputed.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This is news of the unseen that We reveal to you ˹O Prophet˺. You were not with them when they cast lots to decide who would be Mary’s guardian, nor were you there when they argued ˹about it˺.

ayahs.textArabic: إِذۡ قَالَتِ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَٰمَرۡيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكِ بِكَلِمَةٖ مِّنۡهُ ٱسۡمُهُ ٱلۡمَسِيحُ عِيسَى ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ وَجِيهٗا فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَمِنَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Iz qaa-latil malaaa'ikatu yaa-Maryamu innal laaha yubash-shiruki bi-Kalimatim minhus muhul Maseehu 'Eesab nu Maryama wajeehan fid dunyaa wal-Aakhirati wa-minal muqar-rabeen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [And mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allah gives you good tidings of a word from Him, whose name will be the Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary - distinguished in this world and the Hereafter and among those brought near [to Allah].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Remember˺ when the angels proclaimed, “O Mary! Allah gives you good news of a Word from Him, his name will be the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary; honoured in this world and the Hereafter, and he will be one of those nearest ˹to Allah˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيُكَلِّمُ ٱلنَّاسَ فِي ٱلۡمَهۡدِ وَكَهۡلٗا وَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-yukallimun naasa fil mahdi wa-kahlanw wa-minas saaliheen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He will speak to the people in the cradle and in maturity and will be of the righteous."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And he will speak to people in ˹his˺ infancy and adulthood and will be one of the righteous.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَتۡ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي وَلَدٞ وَلَمۡ يَمۡسَسۡنِي بَشَرٞۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ ٱللَّهُ يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمۡرٗا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaalat Rabbi annaa yakoonu lee waladunw wa-lam yamsa-snee bashar(un); qaala kazaa-likil laahu yakhluqu maa yashaaa',(oo) izaa qadaaa amran fa-innamaa yaqoolu lahoo kun fayakoon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: She said, "My Lord, how will I have a child when no man has touched me?" [The angel] said, "Such is Allah; He creates what He wills. When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, 'Be,' and it is.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Mary wondered, “My Lord! How can I have a child when no man has ever touched me?” An angel replied, “So will it be. Allah creates what He wills. When He decrees a matter, He simply tells it, ‘Be!’ And it is!

ayahs.textArabic: وَيُعَلِّمُهُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةَ وَٱلۡإِنجِيلَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-yu'allimuhul Kitaaba wal-Hikmata wat-Tawraata wal-Injeel
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And He will teach him writing and wisdom and the Torah and the Gospel
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And Allah will teach him writing and wisdom, the Torah and the Gospel,

ayahs.textArabic: وَرَسُولًا إِلَىٰ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ أَنِّي قَدۡ جِئۡتُكُم بِـَٔايَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ أَنِّيٓ أَخۡلُقُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطِّينِ كَهَيۡـَٔةِ ٱلطَّيۡرِ فَأَنفُخُ فِيهِ فَيَكُونُ طَيۡرَۢا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۖ وَأُبۡرِئُ ٱلۡأَكۡمَهَ وَٱلۡأَبۡرَصَ وَأُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۖ وَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا تَأۡكُلُونَ وَمَا تَدَّخِرُونَ فِي بُيُوتِكُمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لَّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-Rasoolan ilaa Baneee Israaa'eela annee qad ji'tukum bi-Aayatim mir Rabbikum; annee akhluqu lakum minat teeni kahai'atit tairi fa-anfukhu feehi fayakoonu tairam bi-iznil laah(i); wa-ubri'ul akmaha wal-abrasa wa-uhyil mawtaa bi-iznil laah(i); wa-unabbi'ukum bimaa taa`kuloona wa-maa tadda-khiroona fee buyootikum, inna fee zaalika la-Aayatal lakum in kuntum mu'mineen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [make him] a messenger to the Children of Israel, [who will say], 'Indeed I have come to you with a sign from your Lord in that I design for you from clay [that which is] like the form of a bird, then I breathe into it and it becomes a bird by permission of Allah. And I cure the blind and the leper, and I give life to the dead - by permission of Allah. And I inform you of what you eat and what you store in your houses. Indeed in that is a sign for you, if you are believers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and ˹make him˺ a messenger to the Children of Israel ˹to proclaim,˺ ‘I have come to you with a sign from your Lord: I will make for you a bird from clay, breathe into it, and it will become a ˹real˺ bird—by Allah’s Will. I will heal the blind and the leper and raise the dead to life—by Allah’s Will. And I will prophesize what you eat and store in your houses. Surely in this is a sign for you if you ˹truly˺ believe.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمُصَدِّقٗا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةِ وَلِأُحِلَّ لَكُم بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِي حُرِّمَ عَلَيۡكُمۡۚ وَجِئۡتُكُم بِـَٔايَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-musaddiqal limaa baina yadaiy-yaa minat Tawraati wa-li-uhilla lakum ba'dal lazee hurrima 'alaikum, wa-ji'tukum bi-Aayatim mir Rabbikum fattaqul laaha wa-atee'oon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [I have come] confirming what was before me of the Torah and to make lawful for you some of what was forbidden to you. And I have come to you with a sign from your Lord, so fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And I will confirm the Torah revealed before me and legalize some of what had been forbidden to you. I have come to you with a sign from your Lord, so be mindful of Allah and obey me.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُوهُۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسۡتَقِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innal laaha Rabbee wa-Rabbukum fa'budooh:(u) haazaa Siraatum Mustaqeem
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is the straight path."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely Allah is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him ˹alone˺. This is the Straight Path.’”

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ فَلَمَّآ أَحَسَّ عِيسَىٰ مِنۡهُمُ ٱلۡكُفۡرَ قَالَ مَنۡ أَنصَارِيٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۖ قَالَ ٱلۡحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحۡنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَٱشۡهَدۡ بِأَنَّا مُسۡلِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: ^Fa-lammaaa ahassa 'Eesaa min-humul kufra qaala man ansaaree ilal laah(i); qaalal Hawaariy-yoona nahnu ansaarul laahi aamannaa billaahi wash-had bi-annaa muslimoon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But when Jesus felt [persistence in] disbelief from them, he said, "Who are my supporters for [the cause of] Allah?" The disciples said, "We are supporters for Allah. We have believed in Allah and testify that we are Muslims [submitting to Him].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: When Jesus sensed disbelief from his people, he asked, “Who will stand up with me for Allah?” The disciples replied, “We will stand up for Allah. We believe in Allah, so bear witness that we have submitted.”

ayahs.textArabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا بِمَآ أَنزَلۡتَ وَٱتَّبَعۡنَا ٱلرَّسُولَ فَٱكۡتُبۡنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Rabbanaaa aamannaa bimaaa anzalta wattaba'nar Rasoola faktubnaa ma'ash shaahideen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Our Lord, we have believed in what You revealed and have followed the messenger Jesus, so register us among the witnesses [to truth]."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They prayed to Allah,˺ “Our Lord! We believe in Your revelations and follow the messenger, so count us among those who bear witness.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَكَرُواْ وَمَكَرَ ٱللَّهُۖ وَٱللَّهُ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡمَٰكِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-makaroo wa-makaral laah(u); wallaahu khairul maakireen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the disbelievers planned, but Allah planned. And Allah is the best of planners.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And the disbelievers made a plan ˹against Jesus˺, but Allah also planned—and Allah is the best of planners.

ayahs.textArabic: إِذۡ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ يَٰعِيسَىٰٓ إِنِّي مُتَوَفِّيكَ وَرَافِعُكَ إِلَيَّ وَمُطَهِّرُكَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَجَاعِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوكَ فَوۡقَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيَّ مَرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَأَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَكُمۡ فِيمَا كُنتُمۡ فِيهِ تَخۡتَلِفُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Iz qaalal laahu yaa-'Eesaaa innee mutawaffeeka wa-raafi'uka ilaiya wa-mutah-hiruka minal lazeena kafaroo wa-jaa'ilul lazeenat taba-ooka fawqal lazeena kafarooo ilaa Yawmil Qiyaama(ti); summa ilaiya marji'ukum fa-ahkumu bainakum feemaa kuntum feehi takh-taliifoon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Mention] when Allah said, "O Jesus, indeed I will take you and raise you to Myself and purify you from those who disbelieve and make those who follow you [in submission to Allah alone] superior to those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection. Then to Me is your return, and I will judge between you concerning that in which you used to differ.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Remember˺ when Allah said, “O Jesus! I will take you and raise you up to Myself. I will deliver you from those who disbelieve, and elevate your followers above the disbelievers until the Day of Judgment. Then to Me you will ˹all˺ return, and I will settle all your disputes.

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَأُعَذِّبُهُمۡ عَذَابٗا شَدِيدٗا فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fa-ammal lazeena kafaroo fa-u'az-zibuhum 'azaaban shadeedan fid dunyaa wal-Aakhira(ti) wa-maa lahum min naasireen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And as for those who disbelieved, I will punish them with a severe punishment in this world and the Hereafter, and they will have no helpers."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: As for those who disbelieve, I will subject them to a severe punishment in this life and the Hereafter, and they will have no helpers.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَيُوَفِّيهِمۡ أُجُورَهُمۡۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-ammal lazeena aamanoo wa-'amilus saalihaati fa-yuwaf-feehim ujoorahum: wallaahu laa yuhibbuz zaalimeen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, He will give them in full their rewards, and Allah does not like the wrongdoers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And as for those who believe and do good, they will be rewarded in full. And Allah does not like the wrongdoers.”

ayahs.textArabic: ذَٰلِكَ نَتۡلُوهُ عَلَيۡكَ مِنَ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ وَٱلذِّكۡرِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Zaalika natloohu 'alaika minal Aayaati wa-Zikril Hakeem
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: This is what We recite to you, [O Muhammad], of [Our] verses and the precise [and wise] message.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We recite ˹all˺ this to you ˹O Prophet˺ as one of the signs and ˹as˺ a wise reminder.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيسَىٰ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ ءَادَمَۖ خَلَقَهُۥ مِن تُرَابٖ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna masala 'Eesaa 'indal laahi kamasali Aadam(a); khala-qahoo min turaabin summa qaala lahoo kun fayakoon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, the example of Jesus to Allah is like that of Adam. He created Him from dust; then He said to him, "Be," and he was.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, the example of Jesus in the sight of Allah is like that of Adam. He created him from dust, then said to him, “Be!” And he was!

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡمُمۡتَرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alhaqqu mir Rabbika falaa takum minal mumtareen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The truth is from your Lord, so do not be among the doubters.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This is the truth from your Lord, so do not be one of those who doubt.

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَنۡ حَآجَّكَ فِيهِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِ فَقُلۡ تَعَالَوۡاْ نَدۡعُ أَبۡنَآءَنَا وَأَبۡنَآءَكُمۡ وَنِسَآءَنَا وَنِسَآءَكُمۡ وَأَنفُسَنَا وَأَنفُسَكُمۡ ثُمَّ نَبۡتَهِلۡ فَنَجۡعَل لَّعۡنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faman haaaj-jaka feehi mim ba'di maa jaaa'aka minal 'ilmi faqul ta'aalaw nad'u abnaaa'anaa wa-abnaaa'akum wa-nisaaa'anaa wa-nisaaa'akum wa-anfusanaa wa-anfusakum summa nabtahil fanaj'al la'natal laahi 'alal kaazibeen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then whoever argues with you about it after [this] knowledge has come to you - say, "Come, let us call our sons and your sons, our women and your women, ourselves and yourselves, then supplicate earnestly [together] and invoke the curse of Allah upon the liars [among us]."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Now, whoever disputes with you ˹O Prophet˺ concerning Jesus after full knowledge has come to you, say, “Come! Let us gather our children and your children, our women and your women, ourselves and yourselves—then let us sincerely invoke Allah’s curse upon the liars.”

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلۡقَصَصُ ٱلۡحَقُّۚ وَمَا مِنۡ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innaa haazaa lahuwal qasasul haqq,(u) wa-maa min ilaahin illal laah,(u) wa-innal laahaa la-Huwal 'Azeezul Hakeem
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, this is the true narration. And there is no deity except Allah. And indeed, Allah is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Certainly, this is the true narrative, and there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Allah. And indeed, Allah ˹alone˺ is the Almighty, All-Wise.

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمُۢ بِٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fa-in tawallau fa-innal laaha 'aleemun bil-mufsideen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But if they turn away, then indeed - Allah is Knowing of the corrupters.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: If they turn away, then surely Allah has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of the corruptors.

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ يَٰٓأَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ تَعَالَوۡاْ إِلَىٰ كَلِمَةٖ سَوَآءِۭ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكُمۡ أَلَّا نَعۡبُدَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ وَلَا نُشۡرِكَ بِهِۦ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يَتَّخِذَ بَعۡضُنَا بَعۡضًا أَرۡبَابٗا مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَقُولُواْ ٱشۡهَدُواْ بِأَنَّا مُسۡلِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul yaa-Ahlal Kitaabi ta'aalau ilaa Kalimatin sawaaa'im bainanaa wa-bainakum allaa na'buda illal laaha wa-laa nushrika bihee shai'anw wa-laa yat-takhiza ba'dunaa ba'dan arbaabam min doonil laah,(i) fa-in tawallau faqoo-lush hadoo bi-annaa muslimoon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "O People of the Scripture, come to a word that is equitable between us and you - that we will not worship except Allah and not associate anything with Him and not take one another as lords instead of Allah." But if they turn away, then say, "Bear witness that we are Muslims [submitting to Him]."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “O People of the Book! Let us come to common terms: that we will worship none but Allah, associate none with Him, nor take one another as lords instead of Allah.” But if they turn away, then say, “Bear witness that we have submitted ˹to Allah alone˺.”

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰٓأَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لِمَ تُحَآجُّونَ فِيٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَتِ ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةُ وَٱلۡإِنجِيلُ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦٓۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaaa-Ahlal Kitaabi limaa tuhaaaj-joona feee Ibraaheema wa-maaa unzilatit Tawraatu wal-Injeelu illaa mim ba'dih,(ee) afala ta'qiloon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O People of the Scripture, why do you argue about Abraham while the Torah and the Gospel were not revealed until after him? Then will you not reason?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O People of the Book! Why do you argue about Abraham, while the Torah and the Gospel were not revealed until long after him? Do you not understand?

ayahs.textArabic: هَٰٓأَنتُمۡ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ حَٰجَجۡتُمۡ فِيمَا لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلۡمٞ فَلِمَ تُحَآجُّونَ فِيمَا لَيۡسَ لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلۡمٞۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ وَأَنتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Haaa-antum haaa'ulaaa'i haa-jajtum feemaa lakum bihee 'ilmun falima tuhaaaj-joonaa feemaa laisa lakum bihee 'ilm,(un) wal-laahu ya'lamu wa-antum laa ta'lamoon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Here you are - those who have argued about that of which you have [some] knowledge, but why do you argue about that of which you have no knowledge? And Allah knows, while you know not.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Here you are! You disputed about what you have ˹little˺ knowledge of, but why do you now argue about what you have no knowledge of? Allah knows and you do not know.

ayahs.textArabic: مَا كَانَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمُ يَهُودِيّٗا وَلَا نَصۡرَانِيّٗا وَلَٰكِن كَانَ حَنِيفٗا مُّسۡلِمٗا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Maa kaana Ibraaheemu Yahoodiy-yanw wa-laa Nasraa-niyyanw wa-laakin kaana Haneefam Muslima(nw) wa-maa kaana minal mushrikeen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Abraham was neither a Jew nor a Christian, but he was one inclining toward truth, a Muslim [submitting to Allah]. And he was not of the polytheists.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Abraham was neither a Jew nor a Christian; he submitted in all uprightness and was not a polytheist.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ أَوۡلَى ٱلنَّاسِ بِإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ لَلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ وَهَٰذَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِيُّ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innaa awlan naasi bi-Ibraaheema lallazeenat taba-'oohu wa-haazan nabiyyu wallazeena aamanoo: wallaahu waliyyul mu'mineen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, the most worthy of Abraham among the people are those who followed him [in submission to Allah] and this prophet, and those who believe [in his message]. And Allah is the ally of the believers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, those who have the best claim to Abraham are his followers, this Prophet, and the believers. And Allah is the Guardian of those who believe.

ayahs.textArabic: وَدَّت طَّآئِفَةٞ مِّنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَوۡ يُضِلُّونَكُمۡ وَمَا يُضِلُّونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waddat taaa'ifatum min Ahlil Kitaabi lau yudil-loonakum wa-maa yudilloona illaaa anfusa-hum wa-maa yash'uroon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: A faction of the people of the Scripture wish they could mislead you. But they do not mislead except themselves, and they perceive [it] not.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Some of the People of the Book wish to mislead you ˹believers˺. They mislead none but themselves, yet they fail to perceive it.

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰٓأَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لِمَ تَكۡفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَنتُمۡ تَشۡهَدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaaa-Ahlal Kitaabi lima takfuroona bi-Aayaatil laahi wan-antum tashadoon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O People of the Scripture, why do you disbelieve in the verses of Allah while you witness [to their truth]?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O People of the Book! Why do you reject the signs of Allah while you bear witness ˹to their truth˺?

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰٓأَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لِمَ تَلۡبِسُونَ ٱلۡحَقَّ بِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ وَتَكۡتُمُونَ ٱلۡحَقَّ وَأَنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaaa-Ahalal Kitaabi lima talbisoonal haqqa bilbaatili wa-taktumoonal haqqa wa-antum ta'lamoon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O People of the Scripture, why do you confuse the truth with falsehood and conceal the truth while you know [it]?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O People of the Book! Why do you mix the truth with falsehood and hide the truth knowingly?

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالَت طَّآئِفَةٞ مِّنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ءَامِنُواْ بِٱلَّذِيٓ أُنزِلَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَجۡهَ ٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱكۡفُرُوٓاْ ءَاخِرَهُۥ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-qaalat taaa'ifatum min Ahlil Kitaabi aaminoo billazeee unzila 'alal lazeena aamanoo waj-han nahaari wak-furooo aakhirahoo la'alla-hum yarji'oon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And a faction of the People of the Scripture say [to each other], "Believe in that which was revealed to the believers at the beginning of the day and reject it at its end that perhaps they will abandon their religion,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: A group among the People of the Book said ˹to one another˺, “Believe in what has been revealed to the believers in the morning and reject it in the evening, so they may abandon their faith.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا تُؤۡمِنُوٓاْ إِلَّا لِمَن تَبِعَ دِينَكُمۡ قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡهُدَىٰ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ أَن يُؤۡتَىٰٓ أَحَدٞ مِّثۡلَ مَآ أُوتِيتُمۡ أَوۡ يُحَآجُّوكُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّكُمۡۗ قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡفَضۡلَ بِيَدِ ٱللَّهِ يُؤۡتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-laa tu'minooo illaa liman tabi'a deenakum qul innal hudaa hudal laahi aien yu'taaa ahadum misla maaa ooteetum auw yuhaaaj-jookum 'inda Rabbikum: qul innal fadla biyadil laahi yu`teehi maien yashaaa':(u) wal-laahu Waasi'un 'Aleem
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And do not trust except those who follow your religion." Say, "Indeed, the [true] guidance is the guidance of Allah. [Do you fear] lest someone be given [knowledge] like you were given or that they would [thereby] argue with you before your Lord?" Say, "Indeed, [all] bounty is in the hand of Allah - He grants it to whom He wills. And Allah is all-Encompassing and Wise."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And only believe those who follow your religion.” Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Surely, ˹the only˺ true guidance is Allah’s guidance.” ˹They also said,˺ “Do not believe that someone will receive ˹revealed˺ knowledge similar to yours or argue against you before your Lord.” Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Indeed, all bounty is in the Hands of Allah—He grants it to whoever He wills. And Allah is Ever-Bountiful, All-Knowing.”

ayahs.textArabic: يَخۡتَصُّ بِرَحۡمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُۗ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلۡفَضۡلِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yakhtassu birahmatihee maien yashaaa':(u) wal-laahu zul fadlil 'azeem
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He selects for His mercy whom He wills. And Allah is the possessor of great bounty.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He chooses whoever He wills to receive His mercy. And Allah is the Lord of infinite bounty.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَمِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مَنۡ إِن تَأۡمَنۡهُ بِقِنطَارٖ يُؤَدِّهِۦٓ إِلَيۡكَ وَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ إِن تَأۡمَنۡهُ بِدِينَارٖ لَّا يُؤَدِّهِۦٓ إِلَيۡكَ إِلَّا مَا دُمۡتَ عَلَيۡهِ قَآئِمٗاۗ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ قَالُواْ لَيۡسَ عَلَيۡنَا فِي ٱلۡأُمِّيِّـۧنَ سَبِيلٞ وَيَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡكَذِبَ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: ^Wa-min Ahlil Kitaabi man in taa`manhu biqintaarien yu'addihee ilaika wa-minhum man in taamanhu bideenaaril laa yu'addiheee ilaika illaa maa dumta 'alaihi qaaa'ima:(n) zaalika bi-annahum qaaloo laisa 'alainaa fil ummiyyeena sabeel(unw) Wa-yaqooloona 'alal laahil kaziba wa-hum ya'lamoon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And among the People of the Scripture is he who, if you entrust him with a great amount [of wealth], he will return it to you. And among them is he who, if you entrust him with a [single] silver coin, he will not return it to you unless you are constantly standing over him [demanding it]. That is because they say, "There is no blame upon us concerning the unlearned." And they speak untruth about Allah while they know [it].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: There are some among the People of the Book who, if entrusted with a stack of gold, will readily return it. Yet there are others who, if entrusted with a single coin, will not repay it unless you constantly demand it. This is because they say, “We are not accountable for ˹exploiting˺ the Gentiles.” And ˹so˺ they attribute lies to Allah knowingly.

ayahs.textArabic: بَلَىٰۚ مَنۡ أَوۡفَىٰ بِعَهۡدِهِۦ وَٱتَّقَىٰ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Balaa man awfaa bi'ahdihee wattaqaa fa-innal laaha yuhibbul muttaqeen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But yes, whoever fulfills his commitment and fears Allah - then indeed, Allah loves those who fear Him.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Absolutely! Those who honour their trusts and shun evil—surely Allah loves those who are mindful ˹of Him˺.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَشۡتَرُونَ بِعَهۡدِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَيۡمَٰنِهِمۡ ثَمَنٗا قَلِيلًا أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَا خَلَٰقَ لَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَلَا يُكَلِّمُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَا يَنظُرُ إِلَيۡهِمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَلَا يُزَكِّيهِمۡ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innal lazeena yashtaroona bi'ahdil laahi wa-aymaanihim samanan qaleelan ulaaa'ika laa khalaaqa lahum fil Aakhirati wa-laa yukallimu-humul laahu wa-laa yanzuru ilaihim Yawmal Qiyaamati wa-laa yuzakkeehim wa-lahum 'azabun 'aleem
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, those who exchange the covenant of Allah and their [own] oaths for a small price will have no share in the Hereafter, and Allah will not speak to them or look at them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them; and they will have a painful punishment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, those who trade Allah’s covenant and their oaths for a fleeting gain will have no share in the Hereafter. Allah will neither speak to them, nor look at them, nor purify them on the Day of Judgment. And they will suffer a painful punishment.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّ مِنۡهُمۡ لَفَرِيقٗا يَلۡوُۥنَ أَلۡسِنَتَهُم بِٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لِتَحۡسَبُوهُ مِنَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَمَا هُوَ مِنَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَيَقُولُونَ هُوَ مِنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا هُوَ مِنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِۖ وَيَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡكَذِبَ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-inna minhum lafaree qaien yalwoona alsinatahum bil Kitaabi litah-saboohu minal Kitaab, Wa-maa huwa minal Kitaabi Wa-yaqooloona huwa min 'indillaahi Wa-maa huwa min 'indillaah(i) Wa-yaqooloona 'alal laahil kaziba Wa-hum ya'lamoon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, there is among them a party who alter the Scripture with their tongues so you may think it is from the Scripture, but it is not from the Scripture. And they say, "This is from Allah," but it is not from Allah. And they speak untruth about Allah while they know.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: There are some among them who distort the Book with their tongues to make you think this ˹distortion˺ is from the Book—but it is not what the Book says. They say, “It is from Allah”—but it is not from Allah. And ˹so˺ they attribute lies to Allah knowingly.

ayahs.textArabic: مَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُؤۡتِيَهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡحُكۡمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ ثُمَّ يَقُولَ لِلنَّاسِ كُونُواْ عِبَادٗا لِّي مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَٰكِن كُونُواْ رَبَّٰنِيِّـۧنَ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تُعَلِّمُونَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَبِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَدۡرُسُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Maa kaana li-basharin aien yu'tiyahul laahul Kitaaba walhukma wan-Nubuwwata summa yaqoola linnaasi koonoo 'ibaadal lee min doonil laahi Wa-laakin koonoo rabbaaniyeena bimaa kuntum tu'allimoonal Kitaaba Wa-bimaa kuntum tadrusoon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It is not for a human [prophet] that Allah should give him the Scripture and authority and prophethood and then he would say to the people, "Be servants to me rather than Allah," but [instead, he would say], "Be pious scholars of the Lord because of what you have taught of the Scripture and because of what you have studied."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It is not appropriate for someone who Allah has blessed with the Scripture, wisdom, and prophethood to say to people, “Worship me instead of Allah.” Rather, he would say, “Be devoted to the worship of your Lord ˹alone˺”—in accordance with what these prophets read in the Scripture and what they taught.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا يَأۡمُرَكُمۡ أَن تَتَّخِذُواْ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ وَٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ أَرۡبَابًاۚ أَيَأۡمُرُكُم بِٱلۡكُفۡرِ بَعۡدَ إِذۡ أَنتُم مُّسۡلِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-laa ya`murakum an tat-takhizul malaaa-'ikata wan-Nabiyyeena arbaaba:(n) a`yaamurukum bilkufri ba'da iz antum muslimoon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Nor could he order you to take the angels and prophets as lords. Would he order you to disbelief after you had been Muslims?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And he would never ask you to take angels and prophets as lords. Would he ask you to disbelieve after you have submitted?

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذۡ أَخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِيثَٰقَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ لَمَآ ءَاتَيۡتُكُم مِّن كِتَٰبٖ وَحِكۡمَةٖ ثُمَّ جَآءَكُمۡ رَسُولٞ مُّصَدِّقٞ لِّمَا مَعَكُمۡ لَتُؤۡمِنُنَّ بِهِۦ وَلَتَنصُرُنَّهُۥۚ قَالَ ءَأَقۡرَرۡتُمۡ وَأَخَذۡتُمۡ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُمۡ إِصۡرِيۖ قَالُوٓاْ أَقۡرَرۡنَاۚ قَالَ فَٱشۡهَدُواْ وَأَنَا۠ مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-iz akhazal laahu meesaaqan Nabiyyeena lamaaa aataitukum min Kitaabinw Wa-Hikmatin summa jaaa'akum Rasoolum musaddiqul limaa ma'akum latu'minunna bihee Wala-tan-surunnah,(u) qaala 'aaqrartum Wa-akhaztum alaa zaalikum isree; qaalooo aqrarnaa, qaala fashhadoo Wa-ana ma'akum minash shaahideen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [recall, O People of the Scripture], when Allah took the covenant of the prophets, [saying], "Whatever I give you of the Scripture and wisdom and then there comes to you a messenger confirming what is with you, you [must] believe in him and support him." [Allah] said, "Have you acknowledged and taken upon that My commitment?" They said, "We have acknowledged it." He said, "Then bear witness, and I am with you among the witnesses."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Remember˺ when Allah made a covenant with the prophets, ˹saying,˺ “Now that I have given you the Book and wisdom, if there comes to you a messenger confirming what you have, you must believe in him and support him.” He added, “Do you affirm this covenant and accept this commitment?” They said, “Yes, we do.” Allah said, “Then bear witness, and I too am a Witness.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَن تَوَلَّىٰ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡفَٰسِقُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faman tawallaa ba'da zaalika fa-ulaaa'ika humul faasiqoon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And whoever turned away after that - they were the defiantly disobedient.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Whoever turns back after this, they will be the rebellious.

ayahs.textArabic: أَفَغَيۡرَ دِينِ ٱللَّهِ يَبۡغُونَ وَلَهُۥٓ أَسۡلَمَ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ طَوۡعٗا وَكَرۡهٗا وَإِلَيۡهِ يُرۡجَعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Afaghaira deenil laahi yab-ghoona Wa-lahooo aslama man fis samaawaati wal-ardi taw'anw Wa-karhanw Wa-ilaihi yurja'oon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So is it other than the religion of Allah they desire, while to Him have submitted [all] those within the heavens and earth, willingly or by compulsion, and to Him they will be returned?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Do they desire a way other than Allah’s—knowing that all those in the heavens and the earth submit to His Will, willingly or unwillingly, and to Him they will ˹all˺ be returned?

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيۡنَا وَمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَىٰٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَ وَٱلۡأَسۡبَاطِ وَمَآ أُوتِيَ مُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَٱلنَّبِيُّونَ مِن رَّبِّهِمۡ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيۡنَ أَحَدٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ وَنَحۡنُ لَهُۥ مُسۡلِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul aamannaa billaahi Wa-maaa unzila 'alainaa Wa-maaa unzila 'alaaa Ibraaheema Wa-Ismaa'eela Wa-Iss-haaqa Wa-Ya'qooba wal-Asbaati Wa-maaa ootiya Moosaa Wa-'Eesaa wan-Nabiyyoona mir Rabbihim laa nufarriqu baina ahadim minhum Wa-nahnu lahoo muslimoon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "We have believed in Allah and in what was revealed to us and what was revealed to Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob, and the Descendants, and in what was given to Moses and Jesus and to the prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them, and we are Muslims [submitting] to Him."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “We believe in Allah and what has been revealed to us and what was revealed to Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob, and his descendants; and what was given to Moses, Jesus, and other prophets from their Lord—we make no distinction between any of them, and to Him we ˹fully˺ submit.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَن يَبۡتَغِ غَيۡرَ ٱلۡإِسۡلَٰمِ دِينٗا فَلَن يُقۡبَلَ مِنۡهُ وَهُوَ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ مِنَ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-maien yabtaghi ghairal Islaami deenan falaien yuqbala minhu Wa-huwa fil Aakhirati minal khaasireen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And whoever desires other than Islam as religion - never will it be accepted from him, and he, in the Hereafter, will be among the losers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Whoever seeks a way other than Islam, it will never be accepted from them, and in the Hereafter they will be among the losers.

ayahs.textArabic: كَيۡفَ يَهۡدِي ٱللَّهُ قَوۡمٗا كَفَرُواْ بَعۡدَ إِيمَٰنِهِمۡ وَشَهِدُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱلرَّسُولَ حَقّٞ وَجَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتُۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kaifa yahdil laahu qawman kafaroo ba'da eemaanihim Wa-shahidooo annar Rasoola haqqunw Wa-jaaa'ahumul baiyinaat,(u) wal-laahu laa yahdil qawmaz zaalimeen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: How shall Allah guide a people who disbelieved after their belief and had witnessed that the Messenger is true and clear signs had come to them? And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: How will Allah guide a people who chose to disbelieve after they had believed, acknowledged the Messenger to be true, and received clear proofs? For Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.

ayahs.textArabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمۡ أَنَّ عَلَيۡهِمۡ لَعۡنَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ulaaa'ika jazaaa'uhum anna 'alaihim la'natal laahi walmalaaa'ikati wannaasi ajma'een
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Those - their recompense will be that upon them is the curse of Allah and the angels and the people, all together,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Their reward is that they will be condemned by Allah, the angels, and all of humanity.

ayahs.textArabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنظَرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Khaalideena feehaa laa yukhaffafu 'anhumul 'azaabu Wa-laa hum yunzaroon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Abiding eternally therein. The punishment will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They will be in Hell forever. Their punishment will not be lightened, nor will they be delayed ˹from it˺.

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصۡلَحُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illal lazeena taaboo mim ba'di zaalika Wa-aslahoo fa-innal laaha Ghafoorur Raheem
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except for those who repent after that and correct themselves. For indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: As for those who repent afterwards and mend their ways, then surely Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بَعۡدَ إِيمَٰنِهِمۡ ثُمَّ ٱزۡدَادُواْ كُفۡرٗا لَّن تُقۡبَلَ تَوۡبَتُهُمۡ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innal lazeena kafaroo ba'da eemaanihim summaz daadoo kufral lan tuqbala tawbatuhum Wa-ulaaa'ika humud daaalloon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, those who reject the message after their belief and then increase in disbelief - never will their [claimed] repentance be accepted, and they are the ones astray.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, those who disbelieve after having believed then increase in disbelief, their repentance will never be accepted. It is they who are astray.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَمَاتُواْ وَهُمۡ كُفَّارٞ فَلَن يُقۡبَلَ مِنۡ أَحَدِهِم مِّلۡءُ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ذَهَبٗا وَلَوِ ٱفۡتَدَىٰ بِهِۦٓۗ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innal lazeena kafaroo Wa-maatoo Wa-hum kuffaarun falaien yuqbala min ahadihim mil'ul ardi zahabanw Wa-la-wif tadaa bih:(ee) ulaaa'ika lahum 'azaabun aleemunw Wa-maa lahum min naasireen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, those who disbelieve and die while they are disbelievers - never would the [whole] capacity of the earth in gold be accepted from one of them if he would [seek to] ransom himself with it. For those there will be a painful punishment, and they will have no helpers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, if each of those who disbelieve then die as disbelievers were to offer a ransom of enough gold to fill the whole world, it would never be accepted from them. It is they who will suffer a painful punishment, and they will have no helpers.

ayahs.textArabic: لَن تَنَالُواْ ٱلۡبِرَّ حَتَّىٰ تُنفِقُواْ مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَۚ وَمَا تُنفِقُواْ مِن شَيۡءٖ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِهِۦ عَلِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Lan tanaalul birra hattaa tunfiqoo mimmaa tuhibboon,(a) Wa-maa tunfiqoo min shai'in fa-innal laaha bihee 'Aleem
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Never will you attain the good [reward] until you spend [in the way of Allah] from that which you love. And whatever you spend - indeed, Allah is Knowing of it.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: You will never achieve righteousness until you donate some of what you cherish. And whatever you give is certainly well known to Allah.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ كُلُّ ٱلطَّعَامِ كَانَ حِلّٗا لِّبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ إِلَّا مَا حَرَّمَ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلُ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِهِۦ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن تُنَزَّلَ ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةُۚ قُلۡ فَأۡتُواْ بِٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةِ فَٱتۡلُوهَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: ^Kullut ta'aami kaana hillal li-Baneee Israaa'eela illaa maa harrama Israaa'eelu 'alaa nafsihee min qabli an tunazzalat Tawraah:(tu) qul faa`too bit-Tawraati fatloohaaa in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: All food was lawful to the Children of Israel except what Israel had made unlawful to himself before the Torah was revealed. Say, [O Muhammad], "So bring the Torah and recite it, if you should be truthful."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: All food was lawful for the children of Israel, except what Israel made unlawful for himself before the Torah was revealed. Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Bring the Torah and read it, if your claims are true.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡكَذِبَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Famanif taraa 'alal laahil kaziba mim ba'di zaalika fa-ulaaa'ika humuz zaalimoon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And whoever invents about Allah untruth after that - then those are [truly] the wrongdoers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then whoever still fabricates lies about Allah, they will be the ˹true˺ wrongdoers.

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُۗ فَٱتَّبِعُواْ مِلَّةَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفٗاۖ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul sadaqal laah:(u) fattabi'oo Millata Ibraaheema Haneefanw Wa-maa kaana minal mush-rikeen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "Allah has told the truth. So follow the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth; and he was not of the polytheists."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Allah has declared the truth. So follow the Way of Abraham, the upright—who was not a polytheist.”

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ أَوَّلَ بَيۡتٖ وُضِعَ لِلنَّاسِ لَلَّذِي بِبَكَّةَ مُبَارَكٗا وَهُدٗى لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna awwala Baitinw wudi'a linnaasi lallazee bi-Bakkata mubaarakanw Wa-hudal lil-'aalameen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, the first House [of worship] established for mankind was that at Mecca - blessed and a guidance for the worlds.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely the first House ˹of worship˺ established for humanity is the one at Bakkah—a blessed sanctuary and a guide for ˹all˺ people.

ayahs.textArabic: فِيهِ ءَايَٰتُۢ بَيِّنَٰتٞ مَّقَامُ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَۖ وَمَن دَخَلَهُۥ كَانَ ءَامِنٗاۗ وَلِلَّهِ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ حِجُّ ٱلۡبَيۡتِ مَنِ ٱسۡتَطَاعَ إِلَيۡهِ سَبِيلٗاۚ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنِ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Feehi Aayaatum baiyinaatum Maqaamu Ibraaheem(a); Wa-man dakha-lahoo kaana aamina:(n) Wa-lillaahi 'alan naasi Hijjul Baiti manis tataa'a ilaihi sabeela,(n) Wa-man kafara fa-innal laaha ghaniyyun 'anil 'aalameen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: In it are clear signs [such as] the standing place of Abraham. And whoever enters it shall be safe. And [due] to Allah from the people is a pilgrimage to the House - for whoever is able to find thereto a way. But whoever disbelieves - then indeed, Allah is free from need of the worlds.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: In it are clear signs and the standing-place of Abraham. Whoever enters it should be safe. Pilgrimage to this House is an obligation by Allah upon whoever is able among the people. And whoever disbelieves, then surely Allah is not in need of ˹any of His˺ creation.

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ يَٰٓأَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لِمَ تَكۡفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ شَهِيدٌ عَلَىٰ مَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul yaaa-Ahlal Kitaabi lima takfuroona bi-Aayaatil laahi wallaahu shaheedun 'alaa maa ta'maloon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "O People of the Scripture, why do you disbelieve in the verses of Allah while Allah is Witness over what you do?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “O People of the Book! Why do you deny the revelations of Allah, when Allah is a Witness to what you do?”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ يَٰٓأَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لِمَ تَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ مَنۡ ءَامَنَ تَبۡغُونَهَا عِوَجٗا وَأَنتُمۡ شُهَدَآءُۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul yaaa-Ahlal Kitaabi lima tasuddoona 'an sabeelil laahi man aamana tab-ghoo-nahaa 'iwajanw Wa-antum shuhadaaa':(u) Wa-mal laahu bighaafilin 'ammaa ta'maloon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "O People of the Scripture, why do you avert from the way of Allah those who believe, seeking to make it [seem] deviant, while you are witnesses [to the truth]? And Allah is not unaware of what you do."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, “O People of the Book! Why do you turn the believers away from the Way of Allah—striving to make it ˹appear˺ crooked, while you are witnesses ˹to its truth˺? And Allah is never unaware of what you do.”

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِن تُطِيعُواْ فَرِيقٗا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ يَرُدُّوكُم بَعۡدَ إِيمَٰنِكُمۡ كَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaaa-ayyuhal lazeena aamanoo in tutee'oo fareeqam minal lazeena ootul Kitaaba yaruddookum ba'da eemaanikum kaafireen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O you who have believed, if you obey a party of those who were given the Scripture, they would turn you back, after your belief, [to being] unbelievers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O believers! If you were to yield to a group of those who were given the Scripture, they would turn you back from belief to disbelief.

ayahs.textArabic: وَكَيۡفَ تَكۡفُرُونَ وَأَنتُمۡ تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡكُمۡ ءَايَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ وَفِيكُمۡ رَسُولُهُۥۗ وَمَن يَعۡتَصِم بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدۡ هُدِيَ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-kaifa takfuroona Wa-antum tutlaa 'alaikum Aayaatul laahi Wa-feekum Rasooluh:(u) Wa-maien ya'tasim bil-laahi faqad hudiya ilaa Siraatim Mustaqeem
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And how could you disbelieve while to you are being recited the verses of Allah and among you is His Messenger? And whoever holds firmly to Allah has [indeed] been guided to a straight path.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: How can you disbelieve when Allah’s revelations are recited to you and His Messenger is in your midst? Whoever holds firmly to Allah is surely guided to the Straight Path.

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهِۦ وَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنتُم مُّسۡلِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaaa-ayyuhal lazeena aamanut taqul laaha haqqa tuqaatihee Wa-laa tamootunna illaa Wa-antum muslimoon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O you who have believed, fear Allah as He should be feared and do not die except as Muslims [in submission to Him].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O believers! Be mindful of Allah in the way He deserves, and do not die except in ˹a state of full˺ submission ˹to Him˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱعۡتَصِمُواْ بِحَبۡلِ ٱللَّهِ جَمِيعٗا وَلَا تَفَرَّقُواْۚ وَٱذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ إِذۡ كُنتُمۡ أَعۡدَآءٗ فَأَلَّفَ بَيۡنَ قُلُوبِكُمۡ فَأَصۡبَحۡتُم بِنِعۡمَتِهِۦٓ إِخۡوَٰنٗا وَكُنتُمۡ عَلَىٰ شَفَا حُفۡرَةٖ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ فَأَنقَذَكُم مِّنۡهَاۗ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa'tasimoo bi-Hablil laahi jamee'anw Wa-laa tafarraqoo, wazkuroo ni'matal laahi alaikum iz kuntum a'daaa'an fa-allafa baina quloobikum fa-asbah-tum bini'matiheee ikhwaana(nw) Wa-kuntum 'alaa shafaa hufratim minan Naari fa-anqazakum minh:(a) kazaalika yubaiyinul laahu lakum aayaatihee la'allakum tahtadoon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And hold firmly to the rope of Allah all together and do not become divided. And remember the favor of Allah upon you - when you were enemies and He brought your hearts together and you became, by His favor, brothers. And you were on the edge of a pit of the Fire, and He saved you from it. Thus does Allah make clear to you His verses that you may be guided.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And hold firmly to the rope of Allah and do not be divided. Remember Allah’s favour upon you when you were enemies, then He united your hearts, so you—by His grace—became brothers. And you were at the brink of a fiery pit and He saved you from it. This is how Allah makes His revelations clear to you, so that you may be ˹rightly˺ guided.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلۡتَكُن مِّنكُمۡ أُمَّةٞ يَدۡعُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡخَيۡرِ وَيَأۡمُرُونَ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِ وَيَنۡهَوۡنَ عَنِ ٱلۡمُنكَرِۚ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waltakum minkum ummatuien yad'oona ilal khairi Wa-ya'muroona bil-ma'roofi Wa-yan-hawna 'anil munkar,(i) Wa-ulaaa'ika humul muflihoon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And let there be [arising] from you a nation inviting to [all that is] good, enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong, and those will be the successful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Let there be a group among you who call ˹others˺ to goodness, encourage what is good, and forbid what is evil—it is they who will be successful.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا تَكُونُواْ كَٱلَّذِينَ تَفَرَّقُواْ وَٱخۡتَلَفُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتُۚ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-laa takoonoo kallazeena tafarraqoo wakhtalafoo mim ba'di maa jaaa'ahumul baiyinaat,(u) Wa-ulaaa'ika lahum 'azaabun 'azeem
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And do not be like the ones who became divided and differed after the clear proofs had come to them. And those will have a great punishment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And do not be like those who split ˹into sects˺ and differed after clear proofs had come to them. It is they who will suffer a tremendous punishment.
